name: dev-guardrails
description: Guardrail plugins for Claude Code that keep agent work inside your team's engineering workflow.

plugins.name: git-workflow-guard
plugins.description: Blocks edits, commits, and pushes on protected branches, enforces Conventional Commits, and asks before every push.

plugins.name: secret-scan-guard
plugins.description: Blocks edits, commits, and pushes that put API keys, tokens, or private keys into tracked files, and asks on weaker matches and .env files.

plugins.name: destructive-command-guard
plugins.description: Catches irreversible shell commands (rm -rf on the wrong path, disk wipes, curl | sh, DROP TABLE, terraform destroy) and explains the safer alternative.

plugins.name: protected-files-guard
plugins.description: Stops silent edits to lockfiles, .env and key files, CI config, migrations, and license files. Denies secrets, asks for the rest.

plugins.name: pr-writer
plugins.description: Writes pull request and merge request titles and bodies from your branch's commits and diff, then opens the PR after you approve.

plugins.name: test-before-commit
plugins.description: Runs your project's test and lint commands before Claude commits, and blocks the commit with the failure output until it is fixed.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Flags comments and docs in your changes that read like generic AI boilerplate, and rewrites the ones you approve so they are specific and match your repo's voice.

plugins.name: test-writer
plugins.description: Writes tests in your repo's own style and location, runs them, proves they can fail with a mutation check, and only then shows you the result.

plugins.name: session-recap
plugins.description: Writes a short recap of what a Claude Code session changed, what it affects, and what was tested, from a local activity log and your git history.

plugins.name: bug-reproducer
plugins.description: Fixes a reported bug test-first: writes the smallest failing test in your repo's style, confirms it fails for the reported reason, waits for your approval, then makes the minimal fix.
